title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES MODIFYING THE NOMENCLATURE AND THE RATES OF IMPORT DUTY ON VARIOUS PRODUCTS UNDER SECTION 104 OF THE TARIFF AND CUSTOMS CODE OF 1978 (PD 1464, AS AMENDED)

text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof, as classified under Section
104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be subject to the Most-Favoured
Nation (MFN) rate of import duty in accordance with the schedule indicated opposite each article.

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles specifically listed in the
aforesaid Annex "A" which are entered and withdrawn from warehouses in the Philippines for
consumption shall be levied the MN rates of import duty therein prescribed.

All Presidential issuances, administrative rules and regulations, or parts
hereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect thirty (30) days following its complete
publication in two (2) national newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
Done in the. City of Manila, this 4th day Mewher in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand
firin the lungs
By the President
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
